'''Petrak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who served as a secretary to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Fraabaal]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR:FC" />
